steps.title: Define Project Metadata & Configuration
steps.description: Initialize app metadata, package identifier, and configure Gradle settings for target SDK 34.

steps.title: Establish API & Local Logic Schema
steps.description: Specify local deterministic calculation engine for velocity, score multipliers, and lap statistics.

steps.title: Define Application Theme & Color Palette
steps.description: Setup high-contrast arcade color palette, neon HUD accents, and Material styling.

steps.title: Create Sound & Audio Synthesizer
steps.description: Implement low-latency native sound generation for engine roaring, nitro boost, collisions, and pickups.

steps.title: Build Vehicle Data & Upgrade Model
steps.description: Create car progression data structures, speed, acceleration, handling, and paint attributes.

steps.title: Build Score & Performance Calculator
steps.description: Implement offline mathematical logic for dynamic race scoring, bonuses, and record tracking.

steps.title: Build 3D Pseudo-Perspective Road Segments
steps.description: Implement 3D camera projection mathematics, road curves, elevation hills, and clipping checks.

steps.title: Build AI Traffic & Competitor Vehicle Entity
steps.description: Develop dynamic 3D traffic racers with lane maneuvering, collision boxes, and perspective scaling.

steps.title: Develop 3D Arcade Game Rendering Engine
steps.description: Implement hardware-accelerated SurfaceView with high-refresh game loop, parallax horizon, road rasterization, and particle FX.

steps.title: Design Arcade Main Menu & Garage Interface
steps.description: Design an attractive cyberpunk arcade dashboard with garage car viewer, upgrade shop, and stats.

steps.title: Design In-Game Cockpit HUD & Controls Layout
steps.description: Construct digital speedometer, nitro gauge, tachometer, lap timer, steering pedals, and pause dialog.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest
steps.description: Register game activities with landscape orientation, fullscreen display, and hardware acceleration.

steps.title: Building Turbo 3D Racer
steps.description: Compile and assemble the debug APK containing the complete 3D racing game engine.
